name: rulegate
description: Makes project rules bind instead of decay. Compiles user requests into rule-compliant plans, gates execution scope, keeps an evidence ledger, and checks outgoing claims and style against it. Rules map to binding moments: sequencing to the planner, scope to a PreToolUse gate, claims to a ledger check, style to lint, judgment to an advisory judge. Includes a rules audit that holds project instructions to a requirements/acceptance-criteria bar before classification.
